controlled_change: Developer-only ingestion memory observer plus existing decode diagnostics. Two separate fixed-order control/reuse captures at 12GiB and 1848 slots; the second version adds 250ms and 1s post-destruction observations. No arithmetic, weight, default, capacity or residency change.
correctness: 63 native tests / 48814 assertions passed with Metal validation; 232 tooling tests passed. All eight real-model requests matched prior output IDs and fixed arithmetic dispatch counts. All layer/microchunk/decode/cleanup coverage and source hashes revalidated. Not independent full-logit/state or coding-quality proof.
decision_origin: authored interpretation; original report statuses retained
expected_effect: Locate compression onset and distinguish admitted allocation, process footprint, device resources and cleanup delay before changing memory policy.
hypothesis: A transient allocation or retained GPU users during ingestion could explain the compression that prevents clean scratch-reuse confirmation.
limitations: Diagnostic instrumentation and fixed pair order prohibit latency qualification or a causal reuse speed claim.
Compression onset brackets an interval, not individual buffers; host VM categories overlap and include other processes.
The earlier compressed control was not observed at 250ms or 1s; do not infer its eventual cleanup from a later clean process.
5 tokens/s at 2K/4K, 7K context and sustained coding remain open.
outcome: Initial control compression first appeared between attention encoding and layer completion at layer index 8 as expert ownership grew. Both captures had process-lifetime peaks about 10.56GiB within the 12GiB plan. Initial compressed control retained 3.20GiB immediately after destruction but has no later reading. A separate clean control fell from 1543MiB immediately after destruction to 31.7MiB at 250ms and 1s. Reuse ended around 33MiB. These results demonstrate delayed cleanup in the follow-up, not the cause of intermittent ingestion compression.
smallest_experiment: Use delayed cleanup observations. Consider one bounded existing-core-residency intervention with reuse held on, fixed capacity and independent GPU timing reference; retain the earlier negative core-residency result and require complete-request gains before promotion.
